question: FIXTURE:What documented factors contributed to the landing gear extension anomaly?

passages.document_title: FIXTURE:Factual Report - Landing Gear Actuator Assembly
passages.text: FIXTURE:Post-flight inspection revealed that the main landing gear downlock pin had fractured along the shear plane.

passages.document_title: FIXTURE:Factual Report - Landing Gear Actuator Assembly
passages.text: FIXTURE:Metallurgical laboratory analysis confirmed micro-void coalescence and stress corrosion cracking in the actuator cylinder.

passages.document_title: FIXTURE:Factual Report - Landing Gear Actuator Assembly
passages.text: FIXTURE:Advisory Circular AC 20-109B provides guidance regarding periodic ultrasonic testing of landing gear pins.

passages.document_title: FIXTURE:Factual Report - Landing Gear Actuator Assembly
passages.text: FIXTURE:Mandatory replacement of actuator return spring assembly within 50 flight cycles as corrective action.
